svg.aria-label: Map of Tonga with centered national overview and enlarged island-group details
svg.metadata: Tonga national overview: GSHHS/GSHHG full-resolution shorelines via Basemap 2.0.0 (LGPL-3.0), WGS84, drawn at the exact local-equirectangular-fit-v1 projection of map.bounds (redrawn 2026-10-28, replacing an offset composition with Apache Superset supplements); inset locator boxes re-centred on the true island positions. The enlarged Tongatapu, Vava'u, Ha'apai and ʻEua detail insets use high-detail OpenStreetMap-derived ISO 3166-2 boundary geometry from hyperknot/country-levels-export (© OpenStreetMap contributors; ODbL 1.0), projected with the existing JOURNEY ATLAS multi-region local equirectangular fit. Real Scene coordinates, inset bounds and the centered national overview are unchanged. Reviewed 2026-10-05.
